integrity: Direct independent exhaustion of the inverse-image condition through n=5 agrees with all claimed rank strata, idempotent strata and nonregular strata; a general proof is included. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification covers inverse-image continuous partial transformations of stars K_{1,n} for n>=1, not arbitrary trees, the distinct forward edge-endomorphism monoid, or Krohn-Rhodes complexity. Exact formula novelty may be limited by unindexed older equivalent enumerations.
title: Exact rank, idempotent and regularity profiles of continuous partial maps on finite stars
